item.title: ASCENT: Scale-Complementary External State for Frozen Long-Context Language Models
item.description: External state should become more valuable as a reader becomes more capable, yet long-context evaluations measure memory utility at a single model scale. This paper formulates scale complementarity: the absolute gain from external state increases when reader capacity and a compact state budget are jointly scaled. item.title: Compact Greek Language Models from Scratch: Pretraining 500M- and 1B-Parameter Decoder-Only Transformers
item.description: We present two compact decoder-only language models trained from scratch exclusively on Greek text: LexisLM-1B (1.09B parameters) and LexisLM-500M (502M parameters). item.title: Prove What You Can: Hybrid Neurosymbolic Reasoning for Logical Natural Language Inference
item.description: Logical reasoning over natural language requires both semantic interpretation and deductive search. item.title: Policy Over Purpose: Auditing LLM Content Moderation of Reclaimed Slur Usage
item.description: As Perspective API is deprecated, platforms are turning to large language models for content moderation, encoding policy as natural language that the model must interpret at inference time. item.description: LLM agents increasingly trade on the Web news they read, yet much Web news about listed firms is published after, and about, the price move it reports, so a reader can agree with the market by following it instead of reading the event.
